## File: facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/deprecated/template_exp.py

Prompts

```
['create a BaseExperiment instance with config, create_env, and create_agent callbacks for RL training', 'run the full experiment lifecycle by calling go which creates model, resets, runs, and terminates', 'implement the _create_model method in a subclass to define a custom learning model for the experiment', 'register a batcher with the experiment to ensure proper cleanup when the experiment terminates', 'review the BaseExperiment class lifecycle methods including reset, run, and terminate for RL experiments']
```

```
{'create_BaseExperiment': 'create a BaseExperiment instance with config, create_env, and create_agent callbacks for RL training', 'run_BaseExperiment_go': 'run the full experiment lifecycle by calling go which creates model, resets, runs, and terminates', 'implement_BaseExperiment_create_model': 'implement the _create_model method in a subclass to define a custom learning model for the experiment', 'register_batcher': 'register a batcher with the experiment to ensure proper cleanup when the experiment terminates', 'review_BaseExperiment_lifecycle': 'review the BaseExperiment class lifecycle methods including reset, run, and terminate for RL experiments'}
```
